name: fryup
title: Fry-up
description: A café theme printed like the pink duplicate torn from the waitress’s order pad: the menu written in carbon-violet italic on ruled rows with printed column heads, a double rule before the price column and a blank red ‘No.’ box in the corner — the dark scheme is the carbon sheet itself.

tokens.--font-hand: everything written on the sheet: body text, and in italic the page titles, dish names, prices, descriptions and the answers in the hours boxes
tokens.--font-print: everything the pad’s printer printed, in capitals: the site title, navigation, column heads, section names, box labels, dates, the button, small headings, table heads, tags and pagination
tokens.--font-mono: inline code and code blocks in page text
tokens.--text-hand: size of the written lines: dish names and prices in the order, the answers in the hours boxes, a dish page’s opening line
tokens.--text-print: size of the small printed capitals: navigation, column heads, section names, box labels, dates, tags, pagination
tokens.--tracking-print: letter spacing of the printed capitals
tokens.--color-bg: page background: the carbonless pink sheet (the violet-black carbon sheet in the dark scheme)
tokens.--color-text: body text, titles, the site title, navigation, dish names and prices, the button’s lettering and border
tokens.--color-muted: secondary text: dish descriptions, section names, column heads, box labels, dates, the footer; and the underline of dish names
tokens.--color-accent: links in page text and focus rings
tokens.--color-rule: the pad’s printed rules: under the masthead, the margin rule between the two columns, the frame and double price rule of the order, the hours boxes and the price box, the perforation, the footer rule, the button’s offset shadow, and in page text the table head rule, quotation rule, dividers and picture frames
tokens.--color-feint: the faint ruling: the row lines of the order, lines between table rows and between posts
tokens.--color-no: the red-printed ‘No.’ and its empty box in the masthead — nothing else
tokens.--color-tint: a deeper shade of the sheet: code blocks, inline code, the button on hover
tokens.--color-smudge: the soft halo round written words, where the carbon took
tokens.--sheet: maximum width of the whole sheet: masthead, both columns and footer
tokens.--measure: maximum width of a column of page text
tokens.--col-side: width of the left-hand column that holds the page title (and the home page’s text) on wide screens
tokens.--col-price: width of the price column of the order
tokens.--row: height of one ruled row of the order — every written line there is one row high
tokens.--rule: weight of the fine rules and of link underlines; the double rules are built from it
tokens.--rule-heavy: weight of the heavy rules: under the masthead and column heads, above the footer, round the ‘No.’ box and the button, the perforation dots, focus rings, a link’s underline on hover
tokens.--radius: corner rounding of the button, code blocks and focus rings
tokens.--gutter: space between the sheet and the edge of the screen
tokens.--space-1: hairline gap: under a box label, between tags, the offset of the button’s shadow
tokens.--space-2: small gap: inside column heads, round navigation links, under a section label, the height of the perforation strip
tokens.--space-3: standard gap: between paragraphs, inside the hours boxes, beside the writing in the order
tokens.--space-4: large gap: above page titles, between the two columns, above headings in page text
tokens.--space-5: largest gap: below the last entry of a page, under the footer
